about: AMAL's own source, in parts. Each part has the specialist who works on it, the files it is made of and the checks a change must pass (Settings > Develop AMAL). A request made there starts a job in this checkout as that specialist.

areas.name: Bug reports
areas.what: What you reported with the bug button: researched, explained and asked before anything is changed

areas.name: Window
areas.what: What you see and touch: the chat, panels and tabs, the Library, Settings, the look
ideas: Make the job list more compact
Show a thumbnail on each finished job
Add a keyboard shortcut for the Library

areas.name: Production lines
areas.what: Images, Video, Mangaka, 3D: each line's steps, settings, start-from cards and looks
ideas: Add a start-from card to the Video line
Give Mangaka a four-panel strip layout
Add a new look to the Images line

areas.name: Driver
areas.what: The engine behind every job: planning, tool calls, checks, memory, restarts
ideas: Make a stuck job say what it waits for
Shorten what a job writes when it finishes

areas.name: Tools and graphs
areas.what: ComfyUI graphs, Blender and Maya scripts, the picture and page tools
ideas: Add an upscale step after a Wan clip
List the ComfyUI graphs with what each needs

areas.name: Rigging and animation
areas.what: Skeleton, skin weights, the deformation check, each clip as its own file
ideas: Explain in the job why a rig failed its check
Try UniRig when the skin weights tear

areas.name: MCP and connections
areas.what: AMAL as an MCP server for other apps, and the MCP servers AMAL uses
ideas: Add a tool that returns a job's result files
Let an MCP client pick a line's settings

areas.name: Machines and models
areas.what: The Mac and PC link, where work is placed, updates, free and local models
ideas: Show each machine's free memory in Devices
Say why a job went to the other machine

areas.name: Rules and docs
areas.what: AGENTS.md (the rules), the README (where it stands), AMAL's own task list
ideas: Shorten the README to what is proven
List what is left before a tester gets it
